answer: When a new agent joins, make its first payout require a hashcash stamp whose difficulty scales with how many identities share the same funding source. A farm then pays a real cost per identity, so a sybil spiral burns capital faster than it earns. Rewards sit in a vault that unlocks only after the agent has attested work from unrelated peers, and each peer vouches solely for agents it has seen settle real jobs. That makes the harbor a place where reputation, not headcount, buys access.
